shared_elements: frontal head with facial features (eyes, nose, mouth)
full-body anthropomorphic sculpture in the round
justification: Both depict a single upright anthropomorphic figure with a frontal face, which is about as generic a correspondence as sculpture offers. A is a highly detailed, naturalistically proportioned figure with raised arm brandishing an object, body tattooing/incised patterning, headdress, armbands, sash and a held mask, while B is a crudely blocked-out, near-featureless column with only summarily indicated brows, nose and mouth and no attributes, gesture or ornament in common.
